evidence.detail: Current singlecard is a bare anchor link with pd_legal indicator only — no bug indicator, no interestingness, no n-count, no alternate printed names
entry.mustache is a full <li class='cardrow'> with card.bugs, interestingness, n-count, and decklist_alternate_printed_names — structurally different from singlecard
prepare_card() does not add a 'bugs' attribute to cards, so singlecard contexts (home top_cards, bugs page rows) lack bug data — unifying templates would require data-layer changes
singlecard is rendered inside {{#bugs}} context on the bugs page, meaning it receives bug-level not card-level data — different from entry.mustache's card context

triage.notes: The two templates serve structurally different HTML roles (singlecard = inline anchor, entry = <li> container) and receive different Mustache contexts. Rationalizing them requires aligning the data model as well as the templates; it is not a purely cosmetic change.
